entities.summary: Jonathan Dette is an American drummer best known for his time in the thrash metal bands Slayer and Testament. Over the years, he has also been chosen to fill-in with Anthrax, Heathen, Iced Earth, and Volbeat. Dette also played with Evildead and Impellitteri for several years.
